question: What is the standard method to save your work in PowerPoint?

options.text: Use the File tab and select 'Save' or press Ctrl + S

solution:
The correct answer is __**Use the File tab and select 'Save' or press Ctrl + S**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• To save your work in PowerPoint, you can use the **File tab and select 'Save'**, or simply press the keyboard shortcut **Ctrl + S**.
 
• This method is the standard and most commonly used way to ensure that your presentation file is stored securely.
 
• Using **Ctrl + S** allows quick saving without navigating through tabs, making it especially useful during active editing.
 
• When saving for the first time, PowerPoint will prompt you to choose a **file name and location** for your presentation.
 
• PowerPoint supports saving files in various formats such as **.pptx, .pdf, .ppt**, and others, depending on user requirements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Keyboard Shortcuts:**

 
 
• Ctrl + S: Save the current file.
 
• Ctrl + Shift + S: Save As (allows saving with a new file name or location).
 
 
 
• **AutoSave:**
 
 
• PowerPoint includes an **AutoSave feature** that automatically saves your work periodically when working on cloud-based locations like OneDrive or SharePoint.
 
• Ensure AutoSave is enabled in the toolbar for uninterrupted saving.
 
 
 
• **Saving Formats:**
 
 
• **.pptx:** Default file format for PowerPoint presentations.
 
• **.pdf:** Used to save presentations in a non-editable format.
 
• **.ppt:** Legacy format used in older versions of PowerPoint.
 
 
 
• **File Recovery:**
 
 
• In case of unexpected shutdowns, PowerPoint offers a **Recover Unsaved Presentations** option in the File menu to retrieve lost files.
 
 
 
• **Cloud Integration:**
 
 
• Saving directly to **OneDrive** or SharePoint enables access to your files across devices and facilitates real-time collaboration.
